issues.where: SCOPE (d) WP-41p paragraph (Models.lean ~l.289 'So the open case is EXACTLY the charts with r not an isomorphism'), sorry comment ~l.3540, REPORT theo:local_virt_tame sorries[0].obstruction ('WP-41p proved that this is EXACTLY the open case')
issues.problem: Overstated: only one inclusion is proved (r iso ⇒ descends ⇒ settled). A chart with r not an isomorphism can still descend — e.g. M = X_α itself with the chart (V, V, id): it descends (isLiftableChartMap_refl / IsLiftableChartMap.isDescendingChartMap) whatever r is, and is covered by isVirtuallyTame_of_descending. The gloss 'i.e. π₁(reg V) → π₁(reg X_α) not injective on the component' is informal. The module header itself correctly says 'confined to'.
issues.fix: Say 'the open case is contained in the non-descending charts, hence in those with r not an isomorphism'; flag the π₁ gloss as informal.

issues.problem: 'D₀ of the proof of theo:local_virt_tame, l.2014': l.2014 is the proof of lem:spread_top (d). The developing map D of theo:local_virt_tame's proof is chosen at l.2071 ('We choose a developing map reg(M̃) → X').

issues.fix: Name hgalV ('the model's local Galoisianity at V, available under hgal') in the bridge docstring and the REPORT note.
